summary: The proposal is executable and falsifiable, but its central evaluation scope omits FastSAM even though the source goal, evaluator bindings, detector-retention guardrail, and final experiment all require a real-detector condition.

findings.message: The claim scope freezes only truth and synthetic degraded-truth rollouts, so success could be declared without testing the real detector requested by the source brief.
findings.required_change: Add the frozen FastSAM condition to central_claim.evaluation_scope while keeping non-perception environment, reward, seed, and budget variables paired.

findings.message: The gap is correctly marked provisional because the cited works have not yet passed a frozen comparator audit.
findings.required_change: Preserve the provisional language; do not compile a SOTA claim from the current source brief.
